findings: The book places a 'stop codon' at the end of the gene before the terminator; transcription termination depends on the terminator sequence, not on the stop codon, so the lesson describes only the stop region.
The book gives 12 bases for the temporary RNA-DNA helix; most accounts give about 8-9. Kept as the book's figure. 'promotor' is read as promoter. Both For Information boxes are carried.
